PLAY-REC-D275-NIGHTGLASS-CONVERSATION-001
Player actual V dialogue on Day275 late-afternoon four-horse coach eastward in western Veyr on road toward Caer Veylan/Eastwatch/Nightglass: "We’ve learn quite a bit more from since we were there last. I wonder if anything makes more sense now." This is a reflective in-character invitation for companion discussion, not V acceptance of a new expedition, commitment to entering any hazard, or additional travel choice. Mara (firsthand Nightglass recollection) recalls the previously known silver-veined heart reportedly recovered from Verdana, Sanguine Sovereign and anchor wording, a Silver Court signet, and a voice saying 'My child'; she explicitly notes these observations are not verified to constitute one family story. Cirren, informed from V/party discussions rather than falsely claiming personal attendance at the original Hall scene, distinguishes evidence from assertions; recommends comparing recoverer/carrier identities, dates, documented provenance and first recorded family attribution in available ordinary Hall records. Mara wonders whether tracing a documented movement route could lead to a tangible physical site associated with V's lost House, without promising birthsite, paternal identity or relic function. Fenar humorously questions trusting a speaking heart, independently agrees verification is wise. This is a concrete eligible INTRODUCTION/OFFER of a possible provenance comparison at Nightglass through an informed companion, NOT acceptance by V and not revelation of DM-only Edric's new findings, source records he has not provided, unread letter held by Tamsin or an unseen hidden expedition. No new witness/source contact, correspondence, facts about parentage, new items, combat, expenses, route mileage, rest or dice. Day275 remains late afternoon on the road, V48/48 HD7/7, Fenar59/59 HD4/6, Cirren51/51 HD6/6, LongRest3/6, provisions6 ration-person-days/feed8 horse animal-days, V purse1137gp7sp6cp, four owned horses/coach intact.

PLAY-REC-D275-V-VISIONS-CONVERSATION-001
Day275 late afternoon in four-horse coach heading east on maintained western Veyr commercial highway toward Caer Veylan/Eastwatch/Nightglass. After Mara asked which Nightglass experience has stayed with him most, player exact in-character V statement: "The visions… i haven’t had many since then". This explicitly establishes V has experienced relatively FEW visions SINCE the prior Nightglass visit, not that there were zero, not a precise count/date, and not a fresh vision. Mara responds compassionately that she had wondered whether V still experienced them, recognizing the unsettling older Nightglass voice/heart experiences; Cirren observes that V's memories survived the Severing while origin/trigger of these specific visions is unproved, proposes separating hypotheses rather than declaring Nightglass or the heart the cause. Fenar independently asks whether V misses them. Mara asks whether V pursued visions for evidence or felt them as a glimpse of his personal past. No V follow-up response, choice or emotion assigned. Companion dialogue conveys only known facts/hypotheses, not a new memory, supernatural event, rumor, Edric correspondence or private quest revelation. No game time, travel milestone, checks, spells, items, HP, rations, horse feed, money, overnight/encounter roll or resource change. Party V48/48 full V resources, Fenar59/59, Cirren51/51, Mara unharmed; Long Rest3/6; provisions6 ration-person-days, feed8 animal-days; purse1137gp7sp6cp; four horses and coach healthy.

PLAY-REC-D275-V-IDENTITY-CONVERSATION-001
Day275 late afternoon aboard the V-owned four-horse coach travelling east on the maintained western Veyran Commonwealth trade road toward Caer Veylan, then Eastwatch and Nightglass. Following V's earlier statement that he has experienced relatively few visions since Nightglass, the player says in V's own words: "I think I need to know who I was if I am to become who I want to be." This establishes V's expressed personal motivation and is not a decision to accept an unplayed destination expedition, spend resources, open sealed A-04 or declare truth of visions. Mara independently takes his hand and reflects that recovery of former experiences, people, values and decisions matters beyond an ancestral name or power; promises supportive company without claiming new provenance facts. Cirren observes that recorded actions and other people's assertions about V should be distinguished from proof of inner identity and that V retains choice over current conduct. Fenar gently acknowledges the possible loneliness of incomplete memories and wishes to help recover them without insisting on happiness or present certainty. Mara reiterates the already planned Nightglass examination of heart, visions and historical records, not a new accepted quest or magical result. Cirren asks a concrete, open phenomenological question: do the prior visions feel like V's own lived memories or like witnessing someone else's experiences? V has not answered. No time, travel, encounter roll, rest, character resources, HP, inventory, money, prior correspondence custody or NPC offers changed. Current verified Day275 scene resources: V48/48 HP HD7/7 with full short/long-rest combat and psionic resources; Fenar59/59 HP HD4/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3; Cirren51/51 HP HD6/6 full spells; Mara unharmed. Four horses and coach healthy, Long Rest3/6; rations6 person-days/horse feed8 animal-days; V purse1137gp7sp6cp.

PLAY-REC-D275-V-VISIONS-FIRSTPERSON-001
Player V's exact in-character answer to Cirren's phenomenological question about the old visions: "I feels like me, that’s for sure". Context: Day275 late afternoon aboard intact four-horse coach on western Veyr trade road toward Caer Veylan, Eastwatch and Nightglass. V affirms his subjective visions feel like his own experiences rather than an outside spectator's, not proving objective memory accuracy, trigger, provenance or ancestry. Cirren listens and acknowledges the meaningful first-person feeling while maintaining historical verification remains necessary; suggests comparing actual remembered concrete details against unprompted physical/place/record evidence at Nightglass, avoiding false claims of a revelation. Mara empathizes with recognizing one's identity without enough context and gently supports V. Fenar wishes him more good memories. No new vision, clue, spell, title, family revelation, accepted quest extension or exact recollection added. V still controls further conversation/route action. No in-world time, encounter, rest, resources, money, rations, feed or custody changed. Known party: V48/48 HP HD7/7 full class/psi resources; Fenar59/59 HD4/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3; Cirren51/51 HD6/6 full spell slots; Mara unharmed; coach and four horses healthy. Long Rest3/6; carried rations6 person-days, feed8 animal-days; purse1137gp7sp6cp.

PLAY-REC-D275-276-VISION-TRAVEL-001
Player exact command "do both" in answer to choice to describe one of the already-played Nightglass visions to companions AND continue the coach journey toward Caer Veylan. V's authorized retelling stays within previously played Nightglass material, not a new vision or additional personal words: vision of vast black-marble chamber, silver throne beneath seven branching pillars, an obscured kneeling figure holding V's silver sword, and spoken warning "They will tell you what you were… Do not mistake their memories for your own." This is the established content from the earlier Nightglass scene, not independently certified objective history, true prophecy, or precise identity of the figure. Cirren recognizes this resembles V's current questions about identity, but distinguishes felt memories from proof; Mara notices the held sword and warning; Fenar emphasizes V's present autonomy. Cirren writes only the content V actually shared in his own notebook, no invented provenance/carrier mark or Edric discovery. No magic, psychic resource, HP, inventory, coins or clock change directly from discussion.

Continuing established four-horse coach travel east on heavily patrolled western Veyr trunk towards Caer Veylan after Day275 late-afternoon conversation. Day275 daytime d100 FACE33 vs01–07 previously posted, not rerolled. Day275 EXPOSED night camp genuine Python secrets d100 FACE55 vs heavily patrolled night01–03 => NO event; ordinary peaceful qualifying wilderness Short Rest, no Hit Dice, damage, spells or finite feature expenditure, and weighted Long Rest progress3→4/6 at Dawn276 (not full). Day276 breakfast/horse feed single ordinary allocation for Mara/Cirren/Fenar and V four horses: ration-person-days6→3, horse-feed animal-days8→4. V Reborn does not eat; no double debit or personal spending. Day276 heavily patrolled road daytime genuine uniform d100 FACE69 vs01–07 => no encounter; no type/severity rolls. By Day276 late afternoon ordinary travel reaches cultivated western approaches of Caer Veylan; city gate, traffic and watch posts visible, but no specific arrival processing, fee, purchase, accommodation or new V conversation chosen. No boundary/quest/character changes elsewhere, no additional night/dawn roll. V48/48 HP HD7/7 full combat/Psi features, Fenar59/59 HD4/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3, Cirren51/51 HD6/6 full spells, Mara healthy, four healthy owned horses and intact enclosed coach, personal purse1137gp7sp6cp, LongRest4/6, carried rations3 and feed4 (one ordinary travel day's allowance).

PLAY-REC-D276-CAER-VEYLAN-RESUPPLY-MAGIC-INQUIRY-001
Player exact directive: "resupply and look for magic items" from Day276 late afternoon on west approach to Caer Veylan western Veyr with V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar, four healthy horses and intact coach, after the quiet travel toward Eastwatch. Party proceeds through functioning commercial city gate without invented special scrutiny, false permit, toll or arbitrary encounter; enters commercial quarter and conducts ordinary food/feed top-up. As before, 2014/house standard prices Rations (1 day) 5sp per eater per day and horse Feed (1 day) 5cp per horse-day. Seven-day practical travelling target for three eaters Mara/Cirren/Fenar and four owned horses =21 ration-person-days and28 horse-feed animal-days. Current stores3 rations and4 horse-feed animal-days => buy18 ration-person-days for9gp, 24 feed animal-days for1gp2sp (120cp), total10gp2sp=1020cp. V personal purse1137gp7sp6cp (113776cp) ->1127gp5sp6cp (112756cp), once. No estate money, inn, stabling fee, overnight rest or ration/feed day debit. Full party HP/spells/resources unchanged; LongRest4/6, V48/48, Fenar59/59, Cirren51/51; four healthy horses and coach. Day276 night, further travel or lodging not chosen.

Under existing Market rules one-use unassigned city mechanism, adopt unused UNASSIGNED-CITY-02 prepared merchant-and-traveler-quarter package for new Caer Veylan large city at confirmed opening DAY276, one-time binding of all 10 UC02 M7 item lot IDs and one UC02 maker contact, without cloning any lots or changing prior cities. This is now an accepted in-world first district discovery; owning market file mutations are NOT YET posted, require guarded market activation with stable activation event ID ACTIVATE-M7-UC02-CAER-VEYLAN-D276. Source of exact ownership/terms/mechanics is current trackers/csv/magic-shops/stock.csv and dealers.csv UC02 rows and templates.csv UC02 row; preserve original M7-UC-02-01 through -10 and M7-UC-02-MAKER codes, localize settlement key to Caer Veylan, initial for-sale consignment units1, working property units1 but not unconditional sale, maker finished stock0, opening/review date Day276 plus exact prepared offsets from Dealers. Preserve one-time use marker in Templates on eventual owner sync. No retrospective turnover before binding Day276. Do not claim any prior-day reviews/responses or new magic sources. Mara/Cirren make normal inquiries along Caer Veylan merchant quarter and share only publicly offered or owner-authorized leads: Road Fold Luggage, Boots of the Cloud Jumper one original consignment 325gp, standing midair jump during movement, up to20ft fall mitigation, Saddlebag Book One p37, available on owner terms; Long Pocket Leatherwork, Coiling Grasp Tattoo one original unused magic needle consigned by teamster for375gp, action within15ft DC14 STR vs3d6 force+grapple, attunement, Tasha2020 p123; Stage Veil Cosmetics, one packet of Pixie Dust owner-authorized sale165gp, allows one creature 30ft fly/hover for1 minute, WBtW p212; Leaping Hart Jeweler, owner-authorized used Amulet of Buoyancy 290gp, reaction stand when prone, half speed next turn; from 0HP underwater rises60ft, Saddlebag Book Two p34; Bright Measure Assayer, working Wand of Magic Detection (3 charges, Detect Magic action for1, regains1d3 at dawn, no attunement), indicative price260gp ONLY after completion of a two-day owner's inspection from activation/opening date; not yet sale-ready and no work forced to conclude from V inquiry. Other UC02 contacts prepared locally but NOT introduced to V, no additional item visibility implied. All prices are listed owner-prepared ask, not negotiated or purchases. The city market is a distributed collection of trade shops, not a single magic emporium. No new magic items acquired, charges spent, attunement, or stock sold. Active owner sync remains pending; exact accepted discovery and binding must be preserved without duplicate future prep.

PLAY-REC-D276-PIXIE-DUST-PURCHASE-001
Player direct request at Day276 early evening Caer Veylan merchant quarter, after initial discovery of five local magical offers and one ordinary completed seven-day resupply: "Buy the pixie dust, haggle for a better price". This explicitly authorizes ONE Pixie Dust purchase and a reasonable cash-price negotiation, no holds/other magical spending. Established separate Stage Veil Cosmetics UC02 lot M7-UC-02-08: one sealed packet, original consignment from canceled stage performance, owner-authorized published asking165gp, counteroffers must be approved by original consignor. V bids145gp immediate payment, supported by Mara's eligible meaningful Help, advantage on V Charisma(Persuasion) with sheet modifier+6, predeclared DC15. Genuinely executed Python secrets d20 faces14 and18, keep18+6=24 SUCCESS. Shopkeeper consults original consigning stage performer, who independently consents to cash offer145gp, no extra chance roll or forced owner agreement outside successful negotiation. V pays145gp once from personal purse1127gp5sp6cp ->982gp5sp6cp and takes physical custody ONE genuine sealed packet Pixie Dust, Wild Beyond the Witchlight p212, uncommon consumable (one creature 30ft fly speed and hovering for one minute with safe descent when ended); no attunement/use/charge expended. Lot's available quantity after earlier first-city binding 1->0, status SOLD to V; seller/consignor receive cash under their private brokerage arrangement, not separately debited/paid from V or estate. Other Caer Veylan UC02 stock/offers remain unchanged. Mara, Fenar, Cirren and four healthy V horses/coach unchanged; no overnight rest or DAY277, no new road/encounter rolls. Local shop visit takes about ten ordinary minutes, still Day276 early evening. V HP48/48 HD7/7 all powers full, Fenar59/59 HD4/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3, Cirren51/51 HD6/6 slots L1 4/4 L2 3/3 L3 3/3, LongRest4/6, supplies21 ration-person-days/28 feed animal-days after earlier resupply. Prior unposted Caer Veylan market one-use UC02 activation is already in entry PLAY-REC-D276-CAER-VEYLAN-RESUPPLY-MAGIC-INQUIRY-001; at owner sync bind it once first, then post this sale; do not create a second lot or sell under UNASSIGNED 0 quantity. Both purchase and seller lot availability remain accepted play but NOT YET independently synchronized into owners.
